items.title: D-Street ends in red for a third week on West Asia deal delay, oil spike
items.description: The Indian equity market saw a decline on Friday, ending a lackluster trading week as geopolitical tensions and rising crude oil prices loomed over Dalal Street. With the benchmark indices marking their third consecutive week of losses, market apprehensions were evident. Despite this, the results season brought some volatility, with a notable interest from both foreign and domestic institutions amidst the ongoing market fluctuations.

items.title: Neo Wealth buys a 9.6% stake in Keertana Finserv
items.description: Neo Wealth Partners has taken a significant step by acquiring a 9.9% stake in Keertana Finserv for Rs 230 crore, reinforcing its commitment to the expanding gold loan sector. With the entry of major players like Bain Capital and Tata Capital, Keertana is poised for growth, targeting a portfolio expansion to Rs 6,000 crore by March 2027. The outlook for the Indian gold loan market indicates a promising trajectory ahead.

items.title: Independence Day 2026: How Sensex skyrocketed 8,500% in less than 35 years since 1991 liberalisation reforms
items.description: India’s Sensex has delivered an extraordinary 8,500% gain since the 1991 economic reforms, compounding at about 14% annually. Despite scams, crises and geopolitical shocks, the benchmark has risen across decades.

items.title: Independence Day 2026: 4 stocks that have been part of Sensex since inception. Do you own any?
items.description: From its humble beginnings in the 1800s, when five stockbrokers gathered under the sprawling canopy of a banyan tree outside Mumbai’s Town Hall, the Indian stock market has evolved into one of the world's most dynamic financial ecosystems. What started as informal street trading eventually found a permanent home on Dalal Street as the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) in 1875—Asia’s oldest stock exchange. Today, that shade under a tree has transformed into fully automated, lightning-fast digital exchange. The Indian stock market has shown remarkable growth since its inception, with Sensex rallying to 86,000 last year. As India celebrates its 80th Independence Day, here are four stocks that have been part of Sensex since inception.

items.title: Three key milestones on the road to financial freedom
items.description: Financial freedom is built gradually through understanding, systematic investing and patience. Three milestones—moving from consumption to conviction, investing consistently and creating a financial legacy—can help investors build wealth, stay disciplined through volatility and align money with long-term goals.
